intro.text: A field in Elendel holding a tomb topped by statues of the Last Emperor and the Ascendant Warrior, Elend and Vin.

The field at the heart of Elendel, the hub of the city's canals and the point Scadrial's prime meridian runs through. A tomb there is topped by statues of the Last Emperor and the Ascendant Warrior, Elend and Vin.

description.text: Marewill flowers cover the field all year long, kept blooming by a hot spring beneath it.

The tombs serve as a mausoleum for Vin and Elend Venture and as a museum to the Originators, set in caves where the Originators sheltered during the Final Ascension. Exhibits cover the Words of Founding, the Originators' writings, the Allomantic metals and the Survivor, with copies of the Bands of Mourning and of Sazed's armbands.
